findings.statement: CA9 protein is strongly up in tumour versus normal (log2FC 2.269), ranks second in the convergence ranking, and has a clinical-stage antibody (girentuximab) in Open Targets; the classic ccRCC tissue biomarker.
CA9 up-regulation replicates in TCGA-KIRC paired RNA (log2FC 9.712) but is not prognostic.
NNMT protein is up in tumour (log2FC 2.709) and is among the top target and biomarker ranks, with RNA-level support.
NNMT replicates in TCGA-KIRC and higher expression associates with worse survival (positive Cox logHR 0.301 per SD).
CD70 protein is up in tumour (log2FC 2.421), a membrane antigen with clinical-stage antibody-based agents listed in Open Targets (e.g. cusatuzumab, vorsetuzumab mafodotin).
ENPP3 protein is up in tumour (log2FC 1.544), a surface enzyme targeted by the antibody-drug conjugate AGS-16C3F (phase 2).
SLC16A3 (MCT4, lactate transporter) protein is up in tumour (log2FC 2.279), consistent with a glycolytic, hypoxia-driven programme; no drugs yet.
SCARB1 protein is up in tumour (log2FC 1.837), top of the target-profile ranking, linked to lipid and cholesterol uptake in lipid-laden ccRCC.
PSAT1 protein is down in tumour (log2FC -1.963), top of the biomarker ranking; reflects loss of normal tubule metabolism rather than a target.
PCK1 protein is down in tumour (log2FC -1.859), a gluconeogenic proximal-tubule marker lost in ccRCC.
ALDH6A1 protein is down in tumour (log2FC -1.925) and the gene sits on 14q, which is frequently lost in tumours; loss of tubule identity biomarker.

VHL is recurrently mutated in the combined CPTAC plus TCGA cohort [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=247] [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; patients=511], consistent with the HIF-driven up-regulation of CA9, SLC16A3 and NNMT.

PBRM1 is recurrently mutated [gene=PBRM1; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; mutated_patients=185] [gene=PBRM1; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; patients=511], the second main chromatin driver after VHL.

caveats: Bulk tumour-normal comparison; RNA and protein cohorts differ in matched-normal numbers (75 versus 84).
DepMap dependency of the top up-regulated genes is near zero, so up-regulation does not imply essentiality.
Down-regulated genes mostly reflect loss of normal tubule identity and are biomarker rather than target candidates.
Statements deliberately quote one value per cited record; further layers (purity, CNV, cis effects) are in the ranking output.
